content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Platforms like Gumroad and Payhip may provide an easy way to sell digital products, but they come with significant fees that can eat into creators' profits. By building a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can avoid these fees and keep more of their earnings. This infrastructure works because it is built on open-source tools like Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments, which can be customized and scaled to meet the needs of any digital creator. With this infrastructure, creators have full control over their data and can deploy their store on their own terms, without relying on third-party platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators need to have a clear understanding of their needs and goals. This includes selecting the right tools and platforms to use, setting up payment and delivery pipelines, and configuring security and analytics settings. Creators also need to have a solid understanding of how to use cloud-based services like GitHub Pages and Supabase to host and store their digital products. By having a clear plan and understanding of these requirements, creators can deploy their stack successfully and start selling their digital products confidently.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up a payment and delivery pipeline is a critical step in deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack. Creators need to configure NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency payments and set up Cloudflare Workers to automate delivery of their digital products. This includes setting up secure file storage using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and configuring analytics and tracking settings to monitor sales and customer behavior. By setting up a reliable and efficient payment and delivery pipeline, creators can ensure that their customers receive their digital products quickly and securely.
By building a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can avoid the 10% fees charged by Gumroad and keep more of their earnings.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Going live with a sovereign digital commerce stack requires a clear plan and execution. Creators need to test their payment and delivery pipeline to ensure that it works as expected, and then go live with their store. This includes activating NOWPayments and setting up automatic webhook notifications to confirm payment and delivery. By processing their first transaction successfully, creators can ensure that their stack is working as expected and that they can start selling their digital products with confidence.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling a sovereign digital commerce stack requires a solid understanding of cloud-based services and infrastructure optimization. Creators need to configure their Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments settings to handle increased traffic and sales, and set up automated monitoring and analytics to track performance and identify areas for improvement. By scaling their infrastructure successfully, creators can ensure that their store remains fast and reliable, even as sales and traffic increase.

Can I sell digital products without using Stripe or PayPal? Yes, you can. NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers provide a scalable and secure payment and delivery pipeline for digital creators.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: Set up your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosting environment. Configure NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency payments and connect it to your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend. Set up secure file storage using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Configure analytics and tracking settings to monitor sales and customer behavior. Test your payment and delivery pipeline to ensure that it works as expected. Go live with your store and process your first transaction.
